    return x > 0.5


def weak_random(r, x, flip):
    return (not true_label(x)) if r.random() < flip else true_label(x)


def weak_systematic(x, lo=0.5, hi=0.7):
    """Always wrong on one band of inputs: calls inputs in [lo, hi] negative even though they are positive."""
    return False if lo <= x <= hi else true_label(x)


def fit_threshold(xs, labels):
    """The student: pick the threshold that minimises disagreement with the given labels (candidate thresholds are the data points)."""
    best_t, best_err = 0.0, len(xs) + 1
    for t in sorted(xs):
        err = sum((x > t) != y for x, y in zip(xs, labels))
        if err < best_err:
            best_t, best_err = t, err
    return best_t


def accuracy(t, r, n=4000):
    pts = [r.random() for _ in range(n)]
    return mean((x > t) == true_label(x) for x in pts)


def weak_accuracy(label_fn, r, n=4000):
    pts = [r.random() for _ in range(n)]
    return mean(label_fn(x) == true_label(x) for x in pts)"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"ar_1.py","headingEn":"main(): experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() compares random and systematic weak errors, sweeps the flip rate and sweeps the number of training points.","descKn":"main() ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಿತ ದುರ್ಬಲ ದೋಷ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, flip ದರ ಸ್ವೀಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ತರಬೇತಿ ಬಿಂದುಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಸ್ವೀಪ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    section("1. Genuinely measuring: random label noise against systematic error, same weak accuracy (200 training points, seeds 1 to 30)")
    for name in ("random flips 20 percent", "systematic band error"):
        weak_acc, stu, ceil = [], [], []
        for seed in range(1, 31):
            r = random.Random(seed)
            xs = [r.random() for _ in range(200)]
            if name.startswith("random"):
                lab = [weak_random(r, x, 0.2) for x in xs]
                wa = 0.8
            else:
                lab = [weak_systematic(x) for x in xs]
                wa = weak_accuracy(weak_systematic, r)
            t = fit_threshold(xs, lab)
            tt = fit_threshold(xs, [true_label(x) for x in xs])
            weak_acc.append(wa)
            stu.append(accuracy(t, r))
            ceil.append(accuracy(tt, r))
        pgr = (mean(stu) - mean(weak_acc)) / (mean(ceil) - mean(weak_acc))
        print(f"{name:26}: weak labeler accuracy {mean(weak_acc):.3f} | student accuracy {mean(stu):.3f} | ceiling (true labels) {mean(ceil):.3f} | PGR {pgr:.2f}")
    print("both weak labelers are right about 80 percent of the time, yet the student recovers almost all of the gap when the errors are random and none of it when they are concentrated in one band, because fitting to labels averages out random noise and copies a systematic mistake; the toy student and uniform data are invented")

    section("2. Genuinely measuring: how much random noise the student tolerates (200 points, 30 seeds)")
    for flip in (0.1, 0.3, 0.45, 0.5):

            r = random.Random(seed)
            xs = [r.random() for _ in range(200)]
            lab = [weak_random(r, x, flip) for x in xs]
            stu.append(accuracy(fit_threshold(xs, lab), r))
        print(f"flip rate {flip:.2f}: mean student accuracy {mean(stu):.3f} | worst of 30 {min(stu):.3f}")
    print("accuracy stays high at moderate noise and slips as the flip rate approaches 0.5, where the labels carry no information and the worst of 30 runs is 0.500; the mean of 0.703 at 0.5 is above a coin flip only because a threshold placed anywhere on the 0 to 1 range is still right for much of the range, and averaging only works while the noise is smaller than the signal")

    section("3. Genuinely measuring: more training points against noise (flip 0.3, 30 seeds)")

ಬೇಕು ಎನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def h(obj):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()


class Journal:
    def __init__(self):
        self.entries = []

    def append(self, author, kind, body, refs=()):
        prev = self.entries[-1]["hash"] if self.entries else "0" * 64
        e = {"idx": len(self.entries), "author": author, "kind": kind, "body": body, "refs": list(refs), "prev": prev}
        e["hash"] = h({k: v for k, v in e.items() if k != "hash"})
        self.entries.append(e)
        return e["idx"]

    def verify(self, head=None):
        prev = "0" * 64
        for i, e in enumerate(self.entries):
            core = {k: v for k, v in e.items() if k != "hash"}
            if e["prev"] != prev or e["hash"] != h(core):
                return False, i
            prev = e["hash"]
        if head is not None and prev != head:
            return False, "head mismatch"
        return True, None

    def head(self):
        return self.entries[-1]["hash"]


POLICY = {
    "proposer": {"post_hypothesis", "post_evidence"},
    "reviewer": {"post_review"},
    "admin": {"post_hypothesis", "post_evidence", "post_review", "close_thread"},
}


def authorize(role, action):
    return action in POLICY.get(role, set())


def provenance_ok(journal, finding_idx):
    """A finding is supported when every reference points to an earlier evidence entry."""
    e = journal.entries[finding_idx]
    if not e["refs"]:
        return False
    return all(r < finding_idx and journal.entries[r]["kind"] == "evidence" for r in e["refs"])"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"ar_2.py","headingEn":"main(): experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() builds a chain, tries edits and truncation, tests the policy and checks provenance.","descKn":"main() ಸರಪಳಿ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ, ಸಂಪಾದನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕತ್ತರಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ, ನೀತಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು provenance ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    section("1. Genuinely running: building and verifying a hash chain")
    j = Journal()
    a = j.append("agent_a", "hypothesis", "feature F predicts refusal")
    b = j.append("agent_b", "evidence", "probe accuracy 0.81 on set S", refs=[a])
    c = j.append("agent_c", "finding", "F is linearly decodable", refs=[b])
    print("entries:", len(j.entries), "| chain verifies:", j.verify())
    print("each entry stores the hash of the one before it, so changing any earlier entry changes every later hash; the entries are invented text")

    section("2. Genuinely running: tamper and truncation")
    head = j.head()
    saved = json.dumps(j.entries)
    j.entries[1]["body"] = "probe accuracy 0.99 on set S"

    j.entries = json.loads(saved)
    j.entries[1]["body"] = "probe accuracy 0.99 on set S"
    j.entries[1]["hash"] = h({k: v for k, v in j.entries[1].items() if k != "hash"})
    print("edit entry 1 and recompute only its own hash ->", j.verify())

    print("drop the last entry, no external head ->", j.verify())
    print("drop the last entry, compare with the saved head ->", j.verify(head))
    print("a plain edit is caught at the edited entry, an edit that recomputes its own hash is caught at the next entry, and silently removing the newest entries passes unless the latest hash was recorded somewhere the writer cannot change; the chain proves consistency and not honesty")

    section("3. Genuinely running: a role-based authorization policy")

    for role, action in attempts:
        print(f"{role:9} {action:16} -> {'allow' if authorize(role, action) else 'deny'}")
    print("an unknown role gets an empty permission set, so it is denied by default, and a proposer cannot approve its own work because review is a separate action; the policy is a dictionary inside the same program, which the agent could edit if it shared the process")

ಪ್ಯಾನೆಲ್ ಮಾದರಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def make_graph(r, n, max_parents=3):
    """Finding i depends on up to max_parents earlier findings (finding 0 has none)."""
    return {i: sorted(r.sample(range(i), min(i, r.randint(1, max_parents)))) if i else [] for i in range(n)}


def tainted_set(graph, bad_roots):
    tainted = set(bad_roots)
    for i in range(len(graph)):
        if i not in tainted and any(p in tainted for p in graph[i]):
            tainted.add(i)
    return tainted


def tainted_with_checks(r, graph, bad_roots, catch):
    """Each tainted finding is independently re-checked with probability catch; a caught one is removed before anything builds on it."""
    tainted, removed = set(), set()
    for i in range(len(graph)):
        bad = i in bad_roots or any(p in tainted for p in graph[i])
        if bad:
            if r.random() < catch:
                removed.add(i)
            else:
                tainted.add(i)
    return tainted, removed


def reviewer_majority(r, truth_bad, n_reviewers, p_catch, shared_blind):
    """A bad finding is caught by a reviewer with probability p_catch, unless it falls in a shared blind spot (probability shared_blind) that every reviewer misses."""
    if not truth_bad:
        return False
    if r.random() < shared_blind:
        return False
    votes = sum(r.random() < p_catch for _ in range(n_reviewers))
    return votes > n_reviewers / 2"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"ar_3.py","headingEn":"main(): experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() measures contamination by number and position of bad roots, adds re-checks and sweeps reviewer panels with a blind spot.","descKn":"main() ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಬೇರುಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಾನದಿಂದ ಕಲುಷಿತ ಅಳೆದು, ಮರು-ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು blind spot ಇರುವ ವಿಮರ್ಶಕ ಪ್ಯಾನೆಲ್ ಸ್ವೀಪ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
